cohort: A total of 128 pregnant patients were enrolled, with 55 assigned to a low fibrinogen (FIB) group and 73 to a normal FIB group.
finding: Prenatal fibrinogen (FIB) was negatively correlated with postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) volume and was significantly related to thrombin time (TT), potentially serving as an independent factor to predict the coagulation state of prenatal pregnancy.
